what_to_detect: An object moving to the battlefield meets a copy effect that applies as it enters (a Moved replacement whose substituted ability is a Clone), so it enters as the copy; abilities it had only before copying, such as its own enters-tapped replacement, produce no rewrite.
near_miss: An object moves to the battlefield and meets only other replacements (enters tapped, with counters), entering as itself.
record_fields: rewrite.payload.replaced_by, its line's script API type (Clone) via the sidecar

what_to_detect: A replacement modifies an event (e.g. token creation, token_created updated), and a replacement on an event contained in it (each created object's move to the battlefield, zone_change) is applied afterwards to each object the modified event produced.
near_miss: A containing event is modified by a replacement and no replacement applies to the events it contains.
record_fields: rewrite.payload.incoming / outgoing / result / replaced_by of each rewrite
record ordering (record_id counter) and the shared event subjects that join successive rewrites of one event

what_to_detect: A replacement or prevention effect modifies an event (e.g. damage redirected to another recipient), and a second replacement or prevention effect then applies to the modified event, one that did not apply to the event as first proposed.
near_miss: An event modified by one replacement meets no further applicable replacement.
record_fields: rewrite.payload.incoming / outgoing / result / replaced_by of each rewrite
record ordering (record_id counter) and the shared event subjects that join successive rewrites of one event
